name: GroupA+ focused_tdcc_0124_stab5_turn12_fast_cd3
description: Group A LLM meta strategy。A20（2026-06-18）：重驗 A16 後的平衡型改善。A16 0135_stab2_turn14 在單一近期 replay 中最佳，但 multi-window stress guardrail 較弱。A20 回到 TDCC bands 0/1/2/4、stability_days=5，並把 risk_off/severe turnover cap 降到 12%。此設定讓近期 replay final 高於 A16，同時修復 stress min-Sharpe 轉負與 worst-window final drag 較弱的問題。維持不使用 second-stage pause、不使用 VIX/turbulence。外層控制沿用 FinRL-Trading 風格：fast risk-off、00631L stop/cooldown、signal audit metadata。A20.1 switch layer 加入 total_risk_score>=6 確認條件，在 2026-06-18 最新資料重跑下維持同一切換事件並改善防誤觸語義。A20.2 參考 Applied Quantitative Finance 的 VaR 與局部波動狀態概念，新增 tail_risk_score 候選診斷；重跑後 tail1 會延後 2025-02-27 防守切換並降低績效，因此不升級為 recommended。A20.3 參考 Nonlinear Optimization with Financial Applications 的 downside risk 與 worst-case analysis，新增 downside_deviation、Sortino、worst_daily_return、worst_20d_return 評估欄位；重跑後 recommended 仍為 risk_ma90_dd12_total6_hold5。A20.4 參考 Quantitative Finance for Physicists - An Introduction 的 coherent risk / Expected Tail Loss，新增 value_at_risk_5pct 與 expected_tail_loss_5pct；ETL 較佳的短週期防守規則總報酬明顯較低，因此正式 recommended 不變。A20.5 依第 11 章補齊 VaR 模型檢驗與波動率加權歷史模擬，新增 Kupiec test、VaR breach ratio、volatility-weighted VaR/ETL；5% VaR breach ratio 為 5.13%，Kupiec p-value 0.913，模型覆蓋率未見明顯偏誤。A20.6 最新 2025~2026 fine sweep 後，switch layer 由 risk_ma90_dd12_total6_hold5 微調為 risk_ma80_dd11_total6_hold5_eg015_xg015。A20.7 二次 refine 固定 total_risk_score>=6，進一步微調為 risk_ma75_dd11_total6_hold5_eg0175_xg020；維持 2025-02-25 進防守，但提早至 2025-06-05 退出，final、Sharpe、Sortino 再小幅改善，MDD 持平。

leverage_control._comment: 2026-06-11 cap sweep winner. risk_on cap=20% stays above the observed bull-market max. caution cap=18% avoids the 15% drag seen in zero_overhead. risk_off/severe cap=0% removes 00631L during stress.

fast_risk_off_control._comment: FinRL-Trading import #1. Daily emergency overlay using 0050 as TW market proxy. Conservative default avoids ordinary bull-market pullbacks; if triggered, force risk_off, cap 00631L to 0%, and keep at least 30% cash for a short cooldown window.

leverage_stop_cooldown._comment: FinRL-Trading import #2. Position-level 00631L guard. Conservative default only triggers on larger leverage damage, avoiding the 2025-2026 false-positive drag seen with -10% trailing / -8% short-term settings.

signal_audit._comment: FinRL-Trading import #3. Emit regime, risk overlay, leverage cap, execution, and cost metadata in every GroupA+ JSON output.

second_stage_control._comment: DISABLED — causes false pauses in bull markets. No benefit in backtest.

vix_regime_control._comment: DISABLED — VIX upgrade causes false risk_off during volatile bull markets.

turbulence_control._comment: DISABLED — turbulence upgrade causes false risk_off/severe during volatile bull markets.

backtest_summary.a20_notes: A20（2026-06-18）：重驗 A16 後確認 0135_stab2_turn14 能改善近期 replay，但 stress guardrail 較弱。A20 選用 0124_stab5_turn12_fast_cd3：相對 A16，近期 final +1,390，stress worst final 改善約 10,517，stress min Sharpe delta 由 -0.0013 改善到 +0.0230。代價是近期 Sharpe -0.0104、MDD -0.118pp。

cap_guard_optimized design (2026-06-11) — current default
2026-06-11 cap sweep tested risk_on 18%-25%, caution 12%-22%, risk_off 0%-20%, severe 0%-8%. Best return/score used risk_on>=20%, caution>=18%, risk_off=0%, severe not binding.
Previous configs: v3 (TDCC removed but VIX/turbulence/second_stage still caused -8.5% drag), v4 (VIX/turbulence/second_stage off but 8% cap caused -220K drag)
Key discovery: ALL overlay mechanisms failed due to bull market (2025-2026). The only meaningful control is leverage cap.
Old risk_on cap=8% was wrong — base 00631L mean=10.7%, max=19.5%. Capping at 8% during bull market = -200K drag.
New risk_on cap=20% = never binds in observed replay. caution cap=18% avoids the drag from the previous 15% cap. risk_off cap=0%, severe cap=0%.
VIX, turbulence, and second_stage remain disabled. TDCC bond sleeve is re-enabled with stability_days=5 and 0/1/2/4 bands.
Latest focused stability sweep result: +1.16% vs base approximation, +0.1024 Sharpe, MDD improves by 0.53pp, vol reduces by 0.53pp. Promotion gate: PASS.
Next step: use this as the live GroupA+ config and refresh the cap sweep after the next material regime change.
